requirements.text: We're looking for talented Backend Software Engineers to join a growing engineering team and help design, build, and scale the company's core platform. This is a highly hands-on engineering opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working with modern cloud technologies, and taking ownership of meaningful projects in a startup environment. Startup experience and startup mindset is a must.
3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend development focus.
Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including deploying, managing, or developing containerized applications.
Strong AWS experience, with an understanding of cloud infrastructure and services.
Experience designing and developing REST APIs, microservices, or distributed backend applications.
Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, and system design.
Experience building and maintaining production software.
Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.
Experience with networking infrastructure, proxies, API gateways, or load balancers.
Experience with cloud security, authentication, authorization, or identity management.
Exposure to Kubernetes networking, service meshes, or infrastructure automation.
Experience with AI agents, LLM infrastructure, or emerging AI technologies.
Previous experience working at a startup or on a small engineering team.
Golang experience preferred, but open to engineers with strong object-oriented programming backgrounds in Java, Python, C++, or similar languages.
